name: Bay-controller supervisory data interface
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Collects the assigned bay status and measurements for station-level supervision.
description: Collects the assigned bay status and measurements for station-level supervision. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Bay measurements and statuses” at the input and “Station bay data” at the output. Point identity must match the selected bay configuration.
